description: Listed Building Consent: repair and conservation works to the southern gate pier.
decision_conditions: <p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">The works hereby permitted shall be undertaken in full within twelve months from the date of this consent and retained in place thereafter.</span></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">Before the relevant part of the works commence, details of samples of materials shall be provided to, made available on site, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.</span></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="line-height:normal">Before the start of works, a site meeting shall be held between the Local Planning Authority Conservation Officer and the persons responsible for undertaking the works to ensure that the conditions attached to the Listed Building Consent are understood and can be complied with in full. Notification of the date and time of a meeting shall be made in writing to, and agreed by, the Local Planning Authority. The minutes of the meeting shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the start of works.</span></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">If previously unknown evidence is discovered about historic character which would be affected by the works hereby granted, an appropriate record, together with recommendations for dealing with it in the context of the scheme, shall be approved in writing by the local planning authority before any of the permitted works are begun. The works shall be completed in accordance with the approved details and shall be retained as such thereafter.</span></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">All new external and internal works and finishes and works of making good to the retained fabric shall match the existing adjacent work with regard to the methods used and materials, colour, texture and profile, unless shown otherwise on the drawings or other documentation hereby approved or required by any conditions(s) attached to this consent.</span></span></p>

<div><span style="font-size:12pt">Before the relevant part of the works commence details of the following shall be provided to, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority:</span></div><div><span style="font-size:16px">a) Method statement for</span><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; font-size:12pt"> Portland stone repointing.</span></div><div><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; font-size:12pt">b) Following the above, trial areas, </span><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">agreed in advance with the LPA, </span></span><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; font-size:12pt">for Portland stone repointing.</span></div><div><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; font-size:12pt">c) M</span><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">ethod statement and trial areas, agreed in advance with the LPA, for the proposed steam cleaning method of paint removal.</span></span></div><div><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">d) Trial areas, agreed in advance with the LPA, for the proposed poultice method of paint removal.</span></span></div><div><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">e) Trial areas, agreed in advance with the LPA, for gauged brickwork repair</span></span><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">.</span></span></div>
site_name: Gate Posts Junction Of High Street
reference_no_of_permission_being_relied_: The northern gate pier was destroyed following the collapse of a tree during a storm. Its reconstruction has been approved under separate planning and listed building consent applications (references P/3276/22 and PL/0997/25) and is due to commence shortly.
